name: What is your process for starting a senior home repair project?

mainEntity.name: What is your process for starting a senior home repair project?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our process begins with an initial phone consultation to discuss your specific needs and concerns. Following this, we schedule an on-site visit to thoroughly assess the required repairs or modifications and gather all necessary details. Based on this assessment, we provide a detailed, transparent estimate. Once approved, we schedule the work at your convenience and complete the project efficiently and to your satisfaction.
acceptedAnswer.description: Our process includes a phone consultation, on-site assessment, detailed estimate, and efficient project completion.
